mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and reduced growth momentum, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and reducing real equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing contraction signaled by INDPRO below 100.0 reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A stronger labor market indicated by PAYEMS above 138,000 thousand supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 138000.0.
